## Context
Their old box office contract ends 31 July; first pre-season home game is 8 August.

## Decision
Go live 1 August 2026. Hypercare to 30 September. Old box office stays read-only for refunds until the end of August. Season ticket history is out of scope for go-live.

## Consequences
Missing history later raised as [[Rovers season ticket history and loyalty points missing]]. Slides: [[Vale Rovers go-live readiness slides]].
